definition: A radial throughflow impeller constructor whose blades are bounded by axisymmetric hub and blade-tip mathematical support profiles, while material domains are explicit finite-thickness solids with bore, caps, chamfers, and shroud/hood shell semantics.
semantic_changes_from_v0_2: Open impeller blade-tip support is construction-only and not a display/material surface.
Hub material domain is an explicit finite solid, not only a display surface.
Hub cap faces and bottom thickness are required.
Mounting bore is modeled as a cylindrical removal from the hub material domain.
Closed hood/shroud is a finite-thickness material shell with inner and outer surfaces.
Hub and hood/shroud chamfer or fillet features are declared as material-domain features.
